samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE square 1024x1024 collectible achievement badge illustration for a Twilight viewing party. Subject: FIRST SIGHT OF THE CULLENS. Bella, a fully clothed brunette student in a blue jacket seen in profile in foreground, notices mysterious pale bronze-haired Edward across the Forks school cafeteria; the other four elegant Cullen siblings are soft silhouettes behind him. Intense meaningful eye contact, rain streaming down tall windows, an untouched red apple on the cafeteria table. Style: lush hand-painted gothic romance novel cover meets premium fantasy role-playing video game inventory art, cinematic brushwork and luminous atmosphere, richly detailed oil painting, human faces stylized as fictional characters rather than a photo. Moody blue-green Pacific Northwest palette with silver highlights and tiny burgundy accents. Strong large central subjects clearly readable at 120px. Full-bleed square painting, subject kept within central 75 percent for round and rounded-square UI cropping. No lettering, no title, no watermark, no UI, no badge border, no collage. This is the first in a cohesive Twilight saga series. Return the saved local image path.
